# Captain Nemo

## Overview

- **Gender:** male  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER X THE MAN OF THE SEAS P19](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0019)</sub>
- **Status:** alive  _(assumed)_
- **Titles:** Commander of the Nautilus  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XIV A NOTE OF INVITATION P20](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0020)</sub>

## Appearance

The character appears visibly fatigued, with heavy eyes that suggest a lack of restful sleep. His face carries a sorrowful expression.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXIII THE CORAL KINGDOM P7](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0007)_

## Personality

Captain Nemo is an imperturbable and cool-headed figure who maintains a cold, composed demeanor in all circumstances. He is a highly inventive mathematician and a dedicated collector of art and nature who possesses a refined musical talent. Having placed himself beyond the reach of human laws, he remains entirely independent of society.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER X THE MAN OF THE SEAS P19](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0019), [v1 CHAPTER X THE MAN OF THE SEAS P68](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0068), [v1 CHAPTER X THE MAN OF THE SEAS P87](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0087), [v1 CHAPTER XI ALL BY ELECTRICITY P10](../source/v01-c11.md#nw-v01-c11-p0010), [v1 CHAPTER XIV A NOTE OF INVITATION P46](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0046), [v1 CHAPTER XVIII VANIKORO P1](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0001), +4 more_

## History

Captain Nemo, having renounced terrestrial society to live entirely beneath the sea, captures Professor [Aronnax](../character/professor-aronnax.md), [Conseil](../character/conseil.md), and [Ned Land](../character/ned-land.md), holding them as prisoners aboard his technologically advanced submarine, the [Nautilus](../codex/tech.md#nautilus). Nemo reveals the vessel's secrets, including its electric power and his vast, personally collected museum of marine treasures, while maintaining a life sustained solely by the ocean. Throughout their journey across the [Pacific](../codex/places.md#north-pacific) and Indian Oceans, Nemo leads his captives on underwater hunting expeditions and conducts scientific research, even visiting the wreckage of the [La Perouse](../character/la-perouse.md) expedition. When the [Nautilus](../codex/tech.md#nautilus) runs aground near the island of [Gilboa](../codex/places.md#gilboa), Nemo displays complete confidence in his ship's design, successfully repelling hostile natives with electrified railings. His detached demeanor shifts when he abruptly confines his prisoners and later summons [Aronnax](../character/professor-aronnax.md) to treat a mortally wounded crewman. Following the crewman's death, Nemo leads a solemn underwater funeral procession to bury his companion in a coral forest cemetery.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER X THE MAN OF THE SEAS P7](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0007), [v1 CHAPTER X THE MAN OF THE SEAS P12](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0012), [v1 CHAPTER X THE MAN OF THE SEAS P14](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0014), [v1 CHAPTER X THE MAN OF THE SEAS P17](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0017), [v1 CHAPTER X THE MAN OF THE SEAS P18](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0018), [v1 CHAPTER X THE MAN OF THE SEAS P23](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0023), +302 more_

## Quotes

> "Sir, when I proposed to you to hunt in my submarine forest of Crespo, you evidently thought me mad. Sir, you should never judge lightly of any man."
>
> — Captain Nemo — [v1 CHAPTER XIV A NOTE OF INVITATION P38](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0038)

> "Right! but I told you, M. Aronnax, that the pumps of the Nautilus allow me to store the air under considerable pressure, and on these conditions the reservoir of the apparatus can furnish breathable air for nine or ten hours."
>
> — Captain Nemo — [v1 CHAPTER XIV A NOTE OF INVITATION P48](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0048)

> "With the Ruhmkorff apparatus, M. Aronnax; one is carried on the back, the other is fastened to the waist. It is composed of a Bunsen pile, which I do not work with bichromate of potash, but with sodium."
>
> — Captain Nemo — [v1 CHAPTER XIV A NOTE OF INVITATION P50](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0050)

> "Well, have I not my Rouquayrol reservoir, which can furnish it at need? A tap is all that is required. Besides, M. Aronnax, you must see yourself that, during our submarine hunt, we can spend but little air and but few balls."
>
> — Captain Nemo — [v1 CHAPTER XIV A NOTE OF INVITATION P58](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0058)

> “Well, Professor,” replied the Captain, “we shall show you better than that I hope. As to the mean depth of this part of the Pacific, I tell you it is only 4,000 yards.”
>
> — Captain Nemo — [v1 CHAPTER XVII FOUR THOUSAND LEAGUES UNDER THE PACIFIC P14](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0014)

## Relationships

### [Ned Land](../character/ned-land.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/captain-nemo--ned-land.md)

Captain Nemo holds [Ned Land](../character/ned-land.md) as a prisoner aboard the [Nautilus](../codex/tech.md#nautilus), having stripped him of his freedom to ensure the secrecy of his vessel. While Nemo provides Ned and his companions with food and occasional opportunities to explore the submarine environment, the relationship is defined by the Captain's absolute authority and Ned's involuntary captivity. Tension persists as Nemo maintains his isolationist stance, keeping the prisoners confined despite their inclusion in hunting excursions.

- Commands — captor  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XIX TORRES STRAITS P40](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0040), [v1 CHAPTER XX A FEW DAYS ON LAND P0](../source/v01-c20.md#nw-v01-c20-p0000), [v1 CHAPTER XXIII THE CORAL KINGDOM P42](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0042)</sub>

### [Professor Aronnax](../character/professor-aronnax.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/captain-nemo--professor-aronnax.md)

Professor [Aronnax](../character/professor-aronnax.md) is a captive passenger aboard the [Nautilus](../codex/tech.md#nautilus), kept by Captain Nemo to maintain the secrecy of the submarine's existence. Nemo treats the Professor with a degree of intellectual engagement, providing him with detailed tours of the vessel's advanced technology and inviting him on scientific excursions to the sea floor. While [Aronnax](../character/professor-aronnax.md) serves as an observer of Nemo's life and work, their relationship remains strictly governed by the Captain's role as captor and the Professor's status as a prisoner.

- Commands — captive passenger on the Nautilus  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XIV A NOTE OF INVITATION P19](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0019), [v1 CHAPTER XXI CAPTAIN NEMO’S THUNDERBOLT P53](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0053), [v1 CHAPTER XXII “ÆGRI SOMNIA” P22](../source/v01-c22.md#nw-v01-c22-p0022), +1 more</sub>
